messages:
alex_devex: Morning — quick async check-in for SDKs/quickstarts/sampleapp work.

maria_docs: Did: reviewed the new Python quickstart draft and fixed a broken relative link in sampleapp/README. Blocker: one doc screenshot uses old UI. Today: will update screenshot + push a tiny styling tweak.

sam: Did: landed small auth refactor in sampleapp branch 'auth-cleanup'. Blocker: tests failing on CI mac runners. Today: add a fallback for token lookup and re-run.

ci-bot: Build #7523 · sampleapp · macos-11 · Failed
ci-bot: logs: "ERROR: Failed building wheel for cryptography (exit code 1) - invalid arch for arm64" 
ci-bot: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/7523

priya: I can repro the wheel issue locally on my M1. Might be the prebuilt binary for a dependency. Will try a rebuild with --no-binary and report back.

alex_devex: Nice — @priya if you get a reproducible strace or failing pip log, drop it here. Also: did a pass on the Quickstart code snippets to standardize env var names (REDWOOD_API_KEY vs RW_API_KEY). I switched everything to REDWOOD_API_KEY in the examples.

maria_docs: Heads up — I left one inline comment on the quickstart PR asking to call out the export command for Mac/zsh explicitly. People on mac default to zsh now.

sam: Will update the PR. Also adding a tiny migration note in CHANGELOG about env var rename.

tony: UX ask: can we add a one-line "Run locally" snippet before the full quickstart? E.g. a 3-line command to start the sample server so readers can see results fast. I can draft the copy. :thumbsup:

alex_devex: love that. @tony send a quick copy and I'll wire it into the MD.

kayla: FYI I'm merging the pytest/black dependency bump which should reduce some linter noise that blocked a few CI runs earlier.

priya: Quick note on repro steps for the wheel issue:
```bash
python -m venv venv
. venv/bin/activate
pip install -U pip setuptools wheel
pip install -r requirements.txt
# fails at cryptography binary wheel
```
I'll try building cryptography from source next.

alex_devex: Action items:
- @priya: try source build + paste failing log (ETA today afternoon)
- @sam: update sampleapp env var + changelog (ETA EOD)
- @maria_docs: swap screenshot + update zsh note (ETA tomorrow morning)
- @tony: send 1-line "Run locally" copy (anytime)
- @kayla: monitor flaky tests post-dep bump

maria_docs: One more thing — small doc grammar nit: "an LLM powered" -> "an LLM-powered" in quickstart intro. I can push that tiny commit.

sam: Thanks — will patch that too.

alex_devex: Great run — keep updates here. If CI fix looks hairy we can pair later. :shipit:
